title: 忍
teacherNotes: Release verified and merged L289 from origin/codex/l289-complete-package against latest origin/main. Dependencies are satisfied in playable order through L289; R001-R016 are already shipped.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L289.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Injury/discomfort scenes must be preschool-safe: tiny wound, mild discomfort, no gore, no severe injury, no frightening medical scene.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 忍 as public/assets/lessons/L289/audio/char-u5fcd.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩手上或腳上有一點小傷，表情忍著痛，沒有大叫，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面重點是忍著痛、不叫出聲；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 小狗受傷了，我不忍心看。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小狗受傷了我不忍心看
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩看見一隻小狗有小傷或腳不舒服，表情很心疼、不忍心看，主角媽媽在旁邊陪她。畫面要清楚呈現小狗受傷、主角小女孩不忍心看；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 皮鞋太小，腳痛得受不了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 皮鞋太小腳痛得受不了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩試穿太小的皮鞋，腳看起來很不舒服，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要清楚表現皮鞋太小、腳痛得受不了；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩手上有一點破皮和小傷口，表情覺得痛，主角媽媽正在溫和查看或安撫她。畫面重點是破皮、傷口、很痛；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 大太陽下打球，熱到難以忍受。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 大太陽下打球熱到難以忍受
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和其他孩子在大太陽下的球場打球，天氣很熱，主角小女孩滿頭汗、表情覺得熱到難以忍受。畫面要清楚呈現大太陽、打球、太熱難以忍受；不要畫成危險中暑，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
